items.question: In the UAE, do users need to subscribe manually to receive SMS alerts for energy and infrastructure services?
items.gold: No, SMS alerts are sent automatically to all users who apply for or use entity services.
items.fact: Energy SMS alerts are automatic; no manual subscription needed.

items.question: Which UAE ministry publishes environment and climate change updates that users can subscribe to through newsletters?
items.fact: MoCCaE publishes environment and climate change newsletter updates.
